title: Edit, Repeat and the perform row
thisBuild: Menu is now Edit, with a pencil: tap Edit, then anything, for its settings. Edit twice opens what you touched last.
Repeat sits on the bottom bar beside Hold. Edit, then Repeat, for its rate, style and pattern.

The side dock became the perform row: swipe up (or tap) the strip above the bottom bar. Wheel, filter, Lock, mouth and the rest live there; ⋯ picks them. Hold and Rec are left out, since they are on screen already.
The perform effects (stutter, echo throw, tape stop) are the Throws button in the perform row.
Pads show what moves them: a yellow dot for an LFO, teal for a lane in this loop, red for an FX fader left up.
Settings, Layout: New, New with the row on the left side, or Classic, which puts back Menu, FX and the side dock exactly as they were.
watch: Does the perform row feel better at the bottom, or do you want it on the side? Layout switches it.
Repeat on the bar: is it where your thumb expects?
The dots on pads: do they help, or are they noise?
limits: The full Edit tray (Sound, FX, Keys, Mod, More in one place) is the next step; Edit still opens the same settings as Menu did.
Classic is the rollback switch for this build: nothing else is lost in it.
